name: Body weight
rangeNote: Weight on its own has no healthy range: it depends on your height and build. Body mass index (BMI) and waist size put it in context. Weigh at the same time of day for comparable numbers; day-to-day swings of 1–2 kg are normal.
summary: Your body weight. Followed over time, it shows slow changes that a single reading can't. It doesn't tell muscle from fat or water.

high.meaning: A higher weight for your height is linked, on average, to higher risk of heart disease, type 2 diabetes and some cancers. Where the weight sits (waist) matters as well as how much.

low.meaning: A low weight for your height, or weight loss you didn't intend, can be a sign that something needs a doctor's attention.
commonCauses: Unintended weight loss (worth discussing with a doctor)

sources.title: Body-mass index and all-cause mortality: individual-participant-data meta-analysis of 239 prospective studies in four continents
